title: Match journal fields without conflating their logic
goal: Compare same-field alternatives, different-field conjunction and explicit disjunction against real events from two existing identities.
challenge: Generate four harmless uniquely tagged events using learner and the existing ll-service identity. Compare UID-and-tag, two-tag alternatives, explicit + disjunction and severity filtering. Explain why a supplied tag is not proof of authentication.

steps.command: w=$(mktemp -d "$HOME/operations-journalfields.XXXXXX") && cd "$w" && saved_umask=$(umask) && umask 077 && pwd && here() { case "$w" in "$HOME"/operations-journalfields.??????) ;; *) return 19;; esac; test "${w%/*}" = "$HOME" && test -d "$w" && test ! -L "$w" && test "$(realpath -e "$w")" = "$w" && test "$(stat -c %U:%a "$w")" = learner:700 && test "$(pwd -P)" = "$w"; }; dir_ok() { test -d "$1" && test ! -L "$1" && test "$(realpath -e -- "$1")" = "$w/$1"; }; fresh() { for f; do test ! -e "$f" && test ! -L "$f" || return 19; done; }; here && test "$(df --output=avail -k . | tail -1)" -gt 65536
steps.explanation: Create and record a new private guest workspace. Stop on any failed guard; the free-space check is an observation, not a guaranteed reserve. Do not use the host terminal.
steps.expected: A unique learner-owned mode0700 directory; no originals overwritten.

steps.command: here && fresh metadata.txt and.txt or.txt plus.txt warning.txt exactwarning.txt && a=ll-field-a-${w##*.} && b=ll-field-b-${w##*.} && uid=$(id -u) && service_uid=$(id -u ll-service) && logger -t "$a" -p user.info LEARNER_INFO && logger -t "$b" -p user.err LEARNER_ERROR && sudo runuser -u ll-service -- /usr/bin/logger -t "$a" -p user.err SERVICE_ERROR && sudo runuser -u ll-service -- /usr/bin/logger -t "$b" -p user.info SERVICE_INFO && sudo journalctl --sync
steps.explanation: Four tiny events, existing identities only. runuser here is guest administration, not an authentication claim or account change.
steps.expected: Two tags and two actual originating UIDs, each with one info and one error.

steps.command: here && fresh and.txt or.txt metadata.txt && sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o cat "_UID=$uid" "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$a" > and.txt && cmp and.txt <(printf 'LEARNER_INFO\n') && sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o cat "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$a" "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$b" > or.txt && test "$(wc -l < or.txt)" = 4 && sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o verbose "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$a" "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$b" > metadata.txt && grep -q "_UID=$service_uid" metadata.txt
steps.explanation: Different fields AND; multiple alternatives for the same field OR. Retain UID metadata, not only text.
steps.expected: Conjunction isolates learner-info; tag alternatives include all four.

steps.command:
here && fresh plus.txt warning.txt exactwarning.txt && sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o cat "_UID=$uid" "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$a" + "_UID=$service_uid" "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$b" > plus.txt && LC_ALL=C sort plus.txt | cmp - <(printf 'LEARNER_INFO
SERVICE_INFO
') && sudo journalctl -b --no-pager -o cat -p warning "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$a" "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$b" > warning.txt && LC_ALL=C sort warning.txt | cmp - <(printf 'LEARNER_ERROR
SERVICE_ERROR
') && sudo journalctl -b --no-pager --quiet -o cat PRIORITY=4 "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$a" "SYSLOG_IDENTIFIER=$b" > exactwarning.txt && test ! -s exactwarning.txt
steps.explanation: -p warning includes warning and more severe priorities, hence errors. PRIORITY=4 means exactly warning. + separates OR groups of field conjunctions.
steps.expected: Two info events for explicit disjunction; two errors at severity threshold; no exact-warning event.

hints: Separate OR within one field from AND across fields.
Severity threshold is not exact PRIORITY matching.
review: I retained actual statuses, bytes and relevant identities, including the incorrect case; successful command exit alone is not my evidence.
I can explain the stated limitations and independently meet the Challenge outcomes. Completion records my self-review, not an automatic assessment.
I preserved originals and inspected the exact cleanup inventory before deleting only this recorded practice workspace.
coverage: LPIC-1 v5.0 partial 108.2 journal field/severity queries. Self-reviewed and unscored; no complete-objective, exam-readiness or LPI-endorsement claim.
